title: Golden Hour Harvest

diffuser.notes: Use in a cool-mist diffuser for 30–45 minutes.

why_it_works: Sweet orange brings a bright, sun-warmed lift to cool days; cinnamon adds cozy spice, while vetiver grounds the blend with earthy depth—perfect for crisp autumn evenings.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
Cinnamon can be a skin sensitizer; use low dilution and limit exposure.
